_README:
Identity of every file in vendor/. `node vendor-build.js --check` verifies each
sha256 against the bytes on disk, so a hand-edited or swapped library fails
review instead of shipping.

WHY THIS EXISTS: eleven of these were committed minified blobs with no recorded
version, no integrity hash and no reproducible recipe - React and Babel among
them. "Are we exposed to CVE-X in jspdf?" could not be answered without
reverse-engineering a minified file, and nothing would have noticed a blob being
edited by hand.

A null `version` means it could NOT be established from the committed bytes and
has deliberately not been guessed. Establish it by diffing against a published
tarball, then fill it in here. The sha256 pins the bytes either way, so the file
is still identified - just not yet named.
